resources.title: An Elden Ring Movie ► The Twin Horses of Windwail Knoll
resources.creator: VaatiVidya
resources.noteEs: Video-ensayo cinematográfico de VaatiVidya construyendo una micro-historia dentro del lore: los Twin Horses, su simbolismo y conexiones narrativas. Producción altísima.
resources.noteEn: Cinematic video essay by VaatiVidya building a micro-story inside the lore: the Twin Horses, their symbolism, and narrative connections. Very high production.

resources.title: How to Make a God | Elden Ring Archaeology Episode 27
resources.creator: The Tarnished Archaeologist
resources.noteEs: Análisis arqueológico de cómo el lore define el proceso de deificación en Elden Ring. Conexiones con mitologías reales y la cosmología de los Outer Gods.
resources.noteEn: Archaeological analysis of how the lore defines the deification process in Elden Ring. Connections to real mythologies and the Outer Gods' cosmology.

resources.title: The Great Flood | Elden Ring Archaeology Ep. 26
resources.creator: The Tarnished Archaeologist
resources.noteEs: Investigación sobre el flood mitológico que precede a los eventos del juego. Reading académico de inscripciones del Realm of Shadow y zonas del base game.
resources.noteEn: Investigation of the mythological flood preceding the game's events. Academic reading of inscriptions from the Realm of Shadow and base-game zones.

resources.title: How outsiders brought the Erdtree to the Lands Between | Pre-DLC Special
resources.creator: The Tarnished Archaeologist
resources.noteEs: Investigación de la procedencia del Erdtree con análisis de symbolism mediterráneo y mesopotámico. Pre-DLC pero sus tesis se confirmaron post-SOTE.
resources.noteEn: Investigation of the Erdtree's origin with Mediterranean and Mesopotamian symbolism analysis. Pre-DLC, but its theses were confirmed post-SOTE.

resources.title: The Secret Origins of Grace | Elden Ring Archaeology Ep. 24
resources.creator: The Tarnished Archaeologist
resources.noteEs: Origen de la mecánica narrativa de Grace — qué la guía la dorada que sigue al Tarnished. Lectura gnóstica y arqueológica del símbolo central del juego.
resources.noteEn: Origin of the narrative mechanic of Grace — what guides the golden trail following the Tarnished. Gnostic and archaeological reading of the game's central symbol.
